cohort: 350 mothers and 823 infant stool samples from the HELMi birth cohort
finding: While maternal factors were linked to HMO composition and birth mode showed distinct patterns in infant gut microbiota and HMOs, neither maternal nor infant secretor status significantly impacted infant gut microbiota or child health outcomes.
mod_finding: Analysis stratified for birth mode revealed distinct patterns between the infant gut microbiota and HMOs.
